text: The study's hand-selected dataset covers all institutions that executed N/DPAs from 1993 to 2015, a population of 330 agreements, of which 94 involved publicly traded firms usable for stock price tests.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy Lacine, Stock Price Response to Non- and Deferred Prosecution Agreements (2015). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2629451

isBasedOn.name: Stock Price Response to Non- and Deferred Prosecution Agreements

abstract: Our hand-selected dataset comprises all institutions that executed N/DPAs from 1993 to 2015 (N=330) and are publicly traded (N=94).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: publicly available N/DPAs recorded in the University of Virginia Law Library database
stock price data availability limits the tested sample to 94 firms
